summary: Pou is a long-running mobile virtual pet game by Zakeh, centered on caring for and customizing an alien pet with mini-games, account/device state, and mobile storefront drift.

entries.title: Pou
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Android/iOS app with app version and save/IAP state documented

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only if official app behavior is preserved
emulation.notes: Prefer real mobile hardware for touch, ads/IAP, and save behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official mobile app on real device

primary.why: Pou is a mobile-first virtual pet game, and current Android/iOS builds are the practical official route. Archive fidelity depends on device, app version, ads/IAP, account/save state, and whether legacy BlackBerry or early mobile builds are being excluded.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Android or iOS app on real mobile hardware. Record app version, device/OS, account/login, pet level, coins/items, outfits/wallpapers, mini-games, ads/IAP state, friend/social features, offline behavior, and whether Pou 3D was excluded.

secondary.why: Current Android/iOS are the practical official routes.
It is not the original Pou route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Pou 3D; record whether the run is offline or account-linked.
